What is  Sinusitis?

Sinusitis is an inflammation of the paranasal sinuses, which may be due to the allergy, infection, or autoimmune issues. Sinusitis is often due to the infection within these spaces. When the sinus openings become blocked or too much mucus builds up, bacteria and other germs can grow more easily.
